comparison.objective: Load washable blender parts into a dishwasher while excluding the motor base.
comparison.physical_skill: Place and release two rigid components within a rack while avoiding a forbidden component/volume.
comparison.success_condition: Jug and lid stably released inside the rack; any motor-base intrusion permanently fails the task.
comparison.reason: Selective object placement based on component identity lacks the candidate's physical size-separation mechanism, agitation, and simultaneous recovery/retention requirement.
